note: Corps of Engineers campground in tall pines on the east shore of Cross Lake beside the dam at Crosslake, on the Whitefish Chain, a short walk from town and a paved bike trail. Two swimming beaches, a boat ramp, floating docks and fishing piers. Sites 21-27 on the west edge look through the pines to the lake past a rail fence. --Claude
summary: rec.gov record, rates and 122-site catalog read: $24/$32/$40 (12 full-hookup sites), 50 A, 115 of 116 RV sites 23 ft+ (max 87), no walk-ins, 14-night limit; showers, flush/vault, dump. Closed for the season 2026-10-15 (notice). WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview proposed (no site on open ground at the water; west sites 40-55 m from the shore through pines behind a fence). Pin = catalog centroid, OK. USACE district page 403 (unread).
flags: Waterfront: lakefront -> lakeview (downgrade). Plotting the catalog's site points on imagery, the sites nearest Cross Lake are 21 (46.67374,-94.11323), 23, 25, 27 and 29-31 on the west edge, 35-55 m from the shore through a continuous band of tall pines; the rec.gov photos of 21, 23, 25 and 27 show the lake through the pine trunks beyond a wooden rail fence along the shore. 29 and 31 are tent-only. Nothing places an RV pad on open ground within ~50 m with no barrier, so no site earns lakefront; the photos support lakeview. The two swimming beaches and the boat harbour are day use. If the reviewer reads the fenced pine lawn as an open apron, sites 21, 23, 25 and 27 (all non-electric, sold by the night) are the candidates.

Season: notice 'The Campground will close 15-OCT-2026 for the remainder of the season. This includes all dump stations, all restrooms, and water spigots.' No opening date is published (the peak rate season starts 05-14 in 2026 and 05-01 in 2027, which is not a campground season). Season left unset.
Booking: no first-come at all ('No walk ins allowed. ... staff and volunteers do not make reservations on site'); fcfs 'never' written. reservationCutOff 0 days (same-day online booking).

Phone: stored 218-692-2025; recreation.gov's facility phone is 651-290-5793 (the St. Paul District line). The USACE Cross Lake page (mvp.usace.army.mil) answered 403 and is unread, so the stored local number is not confirmed or contradicted.
Site 20's driveway is 17 ft; it is excluded from the 23-ft count but the campground plainly fits a 23-ft rig.
